subject.title: [Feature]: Plugin API for aborting agent runs (api.runtime.agent.abort)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a plugin runtime abort method by run id, or should plugins use the existing Gateway/session-run-cancel cancellation boundary instead?
rationale: The missing API is real, but the permanent contract decides whether plugin code may terminate agent runs and what ownership/session checks gate that authority.

options.title: Define scoped plugin abort API
options.body: Approve a narrow `api.runtime.agent.abort` contract only with explicit run ownership, session scoping, permission documentation, and regression tests.

options.title: Use Gateway/session-run-cancel only
options.body: Reject the injected runId method and document the supported cancellation path through Gateway or the session-run-cancel SDK surface.

options.title: Defer until related PR settles
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75371 is landed or closed, then reassess whether a separate agent runtime method remains necessary.

recommendation.title: Define scoped plugin abort API
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow `api.runtime.agent.abort` contract only with explicit run ownership, session scoping, permission documentation, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin runtime and SDK history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the product/API choice.
